summary.text: The Sun and Mercury together in the 10th, a career house, form Budhaditya yoga and Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga, which the tradition links with intellect, communication, authority and reputation [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Mars forms Ruchaka yoga, tied to courage and leadership, counted from the Sun in the 10th, a career house, though in a reduced form [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. Most of the career tests lean in favour, while the 10th house itself scores lowest by house strength [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].
summary.timing_line: Best window for career by the engine's timing score: 2029-10-23 to 2032-06-23 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Venus, score 0.84), strongest from 2030-05-01 to 2030-09-22 (score 0.89). Window to avoid: 2028-11-17 to 2029-08-08 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Ketu, score 0.47).
summary.timing_note: These are periods the engine scores as favourable for career; it does not predict when you will act.

claims.text: The house test favours career: the 10th, a career house, in Aquarius is the weakest house by strength, but the 2nd, the 6th and the 11th, career houses, are strong, as are the 6th and 11th from the Moon and the 2nd and 11th from the Sun, career houses [vote:career.house].

The panchanga test favours career: Mars, ruler of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th, the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam, and the 10th from the Sun, a career house, and the Moon, ruler of the vara, rules the 10th from the Moon, a career house, both above their required strength [vote:career.panchanga].

The significator test favours career: the Sun and Mercury, both above their required strength, sit in the 10th, a career house, and Venus is exalted in the 11th, a career house, while Saturn in the 1st falls short of its required strength [vote:career.karaka].

The lord test favours career: Saturn, lord of the 10th, sits in a friend's sign in the 1st but below its required strength, while Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in the 11th, Mercury, lord of the 2nd, is above its required strength in the 10th, and Mars, lord of the 7th, the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam, is in its own sign [vote:career.lord].

The dasamsa, the career chart, favours career: Mars and Saturn both fall in Capricorn with good dignity, the Sun, Jupiter and Venus are mildly well placed, and the Moon and Mercury are neutral [vote:career.varga].

areas.paragraph: The Sun and Mercury sit together in the 10th, a career house, forming Budhaditya yoga, the combination of Mercury and the Sun in the same sign, and Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga, a combination joining the lord of an angular house with the lord of a trine house [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja]. Mercury there is lord of the 2nd and lord of the 5th, with the Sun beside it in the 10th [rule:place.l2_h10] [rule:place.l5_h10] [rule:place.sun_h10]. Mars adds Ruchaka yoga, the great-person combination of Mars, counted from the ascendant and from the Sun [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. The tradition links Budhaditya yoga with intellect and communication, Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga with authority, reputation and career, and Ruchaka yoga with courage and leadership [rule:yoga.budhaditya] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. The soft spot is the 10th itself, lowest of its houses by house strength, with its ruler Saturn short of its required strength, while Ruchaka yoga is held back by an aspect from Saturn and an awkward house placement [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [rule:yoga.ruchaka]. Five of the seven tests agree, two abstain and none goes against [vote:career.house] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.karaka] [vote:career.varga] [vote:career.panchanga].

claims.text: The KP test favours marriage: the 7th cusp lies in Saturn's star with Mercury as sub-lord, and at the star-lord level Mars, occupying and owning the 7th, signifies the 7th, a matter house, and decides for [vote:marriage.kp].

The Jaimini image-point test goes against marriage: the Upapada falls in Gemini in the 2nd, a marriage house, holding Rahu and no benefic, and the sign after it and the A7 are empty of benefics [vote:marriage.arudha].

The house test favours marriage: the 2nd, the 8th and the 11th, marriage houses, are strong, the 7th, a marriage house, is middling, and the 1st from the Sun, the 7th's Bhavat Bhavam, is the weakest [vote:marriage.house].

The panchanga test favours marriage: Mars, ruler of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th, a marriage house, and the 7th and 2nd from the Moon, and stands above its required strength [vote:marriage.panchanga].

The significator test favours marriage: Venus is exalted in the 11th, a marriage house, Jupiter sits in an enemy's sign in the 1st yet above its required strength, and Mercury is neutral in the 10th [vote:marriage.karaka].

The lord test favours marriage: Mars, lord of the 7th, a marriage house, sits in its own sign in the 7th above its required strength, and Venus, lord of the 1st, the 7th's Bhavat Bhavam, is exalted in the 11th [vote:marriage.lord].
The navamsa favours marriage: Saturn in Capricorn scores best, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus are mildly well placed, and the Sun in Gemini is neutral [vote:marriage.varga].
